scripts.android:sync: npm run sync:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64 ./gradlew assembleDebug && node ../scripts/copy-apk.js debug
